content.comment_body: Hello, I am new to [company_name] PLCs and need some guidance. I have a project file that I want to upload to my PLC, but I receive an incompatibility error because it was created with default settings in the hardware type ([product_name] [version_no]). Is there a way to change the hardware type so I can upload my program without recreating everything? I’ve attached the project and hardware options for reference. Thanks for your help.

I'm not sure why you opened another topic about the same issue. You asked about this in your previous post regarding changing hardware type from [product_name] [version_no] to [product_name] [article_no], and you already received all available answers there. For future reference, please avoid posting duplicate topics.

This thread is closed due to the question being posted twice. The second thread about changing hardware type from [product_name] [version_no] to [product_name] [article_no] was already published in the [product_name] - Software conference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The main user experience issue reported is the difficulty and lack of clear guidance in changing the hardware type of a project within the [company_name] PLC software, especially when trying to transfer a project from one hardware version to another. Users are frustrated by the absence of a straightforward way to ensure compatibility, leading to concerns about needing to redo significant work and dissatisfaction with how incompatibility is communicated by the software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy method in the software to change or convert the project’s hardware type, allowing for upload to different PLC hardware versions without having to recreate the project from scratch.
